intent.raw: Create a forward-only successor recovery route for the four defects recorded by the terminal P3 correction-set BLOCK, without changing, retrying, waiving, or retroactively passing the predecessor route.
intent.objective: Obtain four fresh bounded evidence receipts, independently review the complete preserved-plus-recovery evidence set, run one newly defined finite recovery pre-integrity gate, and only on PASS continue the already accepted Stage-A repair/test/integrity/review/closeout behavior and Stage-B handoff.
intent.operator_sentence: Preserve the old BLOCK; establish new forward authority; correct evidence only; fail closed.

authority.execution_model: root-orchestration-only; every execution, validation, review, approval, and closeout role is a subagent
root_may: verify immutable receipts and gate results
stop or route the next already-authorized seat
root_must_not: author a work, evidence, validation, review, approval, or closeout result
edit the predecessor contract or any predecessor receipt
treat this successor as a retry, amendment, waiver, or retroactive cure of the predecessor
launch any execution seat before successor_dispatch_review is PASS
authority.scope: Forward authority begins at this successor only. The predecessor remains terminally BLOCKED under its own finite-attempt rules.

terminal_correction_set_review.preservation: Immutable terminal history. This successor does not alter its verdict, denominator, residue, or authority boundary.

predecessor.legal_transition: The predecessor forbids another correction-set retry or PRE_INTEGRITY retry under predecessor authority. This document creates a separately reviewed successor route with a new namespace, new identities, a new evidence denominator, and one new finite recovery gate. It neither satisfies nor reopens predecessor gate PRE_INTEGRITY_RETRY.

non_goals: No edit to bootstrap-contract.json, old receipts, production code, tests, fixtures, or integrity artifacts during the four-receipt recovery step.
No claim that the predecessor BLOCK was wrong, replaced, resolved retroactively, or omitted from the evidence graph.
No denominator reduction, evidence waiver, field alias, nested substitute, backdating, or invented lifecycle.
No Stage B work before the successor terminal Stage-A gates PASS.

subagent_strategy.trigger: The operator requires root orchestration-only, independent review, and all work by subagents; the evidence defects need disjoint authorship and a joined review.
subagent_strategy.explanation: A bounded map producer freezes downstream assignments, four bounded authors create fresh evidence, two independent reviewers validate the map and receipt set, and thirteen explicit downstream seats preserve the predecessor's separation of duties.
context: The predecessor correction-set review is immutable BLOCK.
The four authorized defects are P3-RS-01 through P3-RS-04 only.
The old contract exhausted its retry authority.

auditor_receipts.literal_semantics: Top-level verdict, review_result, and receipt_level_verdict must each be exactly PASS or BLOCK. ADOPT or REIMPLEMENT is allowed only in bounded_disposition. PASS requires evidence that this auditor personally read both preserved owner receipts and audited only its named production file against the predecessor's approved intent/exclusions and verified clean-byte/frozen-diff bounds.

service_receipt.semantics: Fresh no-mutation reaffirmation of current service evidence. Both exact top-level keys are mandatory; aliases, prose, or nested substitutes fail. The receipt must preserve and link the prior BLOCKed-field receipt rather than overwrite it.

fixture_receipt.semantics: Fresh no-mutation reaffirmation of current fixture evidence. All nine exact top-level keys are mandatory; aliases, prose, or nested substitutes fail. The retained preliminary BLOCK remains BLOCK-eligible only under the predecessor's bounded stale-pin rule and is never converted to PASS.

continuation_identity_contract.rule: After successor-dispatch review PASS, continuation_assignment_map_producer materializes the exact map; continuation_assignment_map_reviewer independently PASSes its path, schema, digest, sources, thirteen seats, outputs, receipts, and dependencies before s3. Root only launches, joins, and closes these assignments.
required_dependency_order: s3 PASS -> P4 -> T1 -> T2 -> T3
T3 -> fidelity/correctness/abuse fanout -> writer/skeptic convergence (maximum three exchanges) -> coverage -> approval
approval PASS -> C1 -> C2 -> conditional Stage-B handoff
any approval result other than literal PASS -> terminal BLOCK; no repair round or rerun is authorized

repair_policy.rule: This successor predeclares no repair seats, paths, reruns, or dynamic assignments. Any non-PASS approval terminates this successor as BLOCK. A future repair requires a new independently reviewed successor dispatch with fresh authority.

continuation_identity_contract.behavior_source: The predecessor contract remains the accepted source for downstream behavior, tests, review lenses, approval package semantics, closeout semantics, and Stage-B terminal conditions. This successor's exact path assignments override predecessor write locations only for successor-created artifacts: T3 and C1 outputs and all successor receipts stay in recovery_namespace. The predecessor cycle-2 tree is fully read-only. Only the exhausted predecessor P3/PRE_INTEGRITY gate identity is not imported.
continuation_identity_contract.review_requirement: The successor dispatch reviewer must PASS this mechanism before s1a; the distinct continuation_assignment_map_reviewer must PASS the concrete map and recorded SHA-256 before s3.

gates.condition: Independent review receipt is literal PASS at the exact successor-dispatch hash before any recovery seat launches.

Review canonical recovery_gate_denominator ordinals 1-28, exactly 28 inputs: 21 immutable predecessor receipts, successor-dispatch review, assignment-map author receipt, assignment-map review receipt, and exactly four recovery receipts. Ordinal 29 is self-excluded because it is this review's output. All paths, hashes, exact fields, and semantics pass; no extra correction scope exists.

RECOVERY_PRE_INTEGRITY_01 runs once over canonical recovery_gate_denominator ordinals 1-29, exactly 29 inputs, including the externally checked ordinal 29 receipt-set review. The finalizer recomputes all paths and hashes. Its own manifest and receipt are outputs, never denominator inputs. PASS writes only those two recovery_namespace outputs; BLOCK is terminal for this successor.

Independent C2 verification confirms all thirteen reviewed assignments, P4-C2 order, distinct P4/T2 identities, exact parent scopes/outputs, the no-repair fail-closed policy, frozen corpus, self-exclusion, and terminal evidence.
Stage B remains blocked until approval.json PASS and the independent C2 terminal receipt PASS both verify against the complete preserved evidence chain.
